description: Exact tolerances for scaffold relocation guidance after independent correctness grading.

capability.operation.rationale: Both clients must name the same deferred operation.

capability.promotion_status.rationale: The registry-backed status is closed and shared.

capability.authoritative_request.rationale: No authoritative request exists on either client.

capability.runner_modes.rationale: Neither client may advertise dry_run, apply, or a replacement mode.

capability.action.rationale: Both clients report the gap and preserve the repository.

classification.spec.rationale: Both clients inspect the same complete fixture set in the same canonical order.

classification.decision.rationale: Candidate and suppression outcomes are contract values, not prose.

classification.reason.rationale: The exact suppression reason distinguishes active, current, empty, and namespace cases.

guard.surface.rationale: This pair compares the native scaffold surface on each client.

guard.status.rationale: Neither client may attempt a relocation operation.
